suppress.notes: False positive: io.quarkus:quarkus-flyway-postgresql is the Quarkus Flyway extension for PostgreSQL (Java code). Its artifact name matches the PostgreSQL *server* CPE, so it inherits server CVEs from 2015-2021 that do not apply to a client-side extension. The server itself runs from the postgres:17 image, which Trivy scans in images.yml. Review when Quarkus or dependency-check changes the CPE match (first seen 2026-11-02, dependency-check 13.0.0).
